decks.notes: The main concept of the deck is to utilize the graveyard as a resource to quickly fill the board with creatures such as Ichorid, Narcomoeba, Prized Amalgam, and Hollow One. The key strategy involves using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to fill the graveyard with cards like Golgari Thug and Golgari Grave-Troll. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect the combo. Additionally, Creeping Chill provides reach and Silversmote Ghoul offers additional synergy with the graveyard strategy.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful card advantage spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, along with disruption from cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation. The deck also includes efficient removal in Fatal Push and disruptive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Psychic Frog. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for extra value by recasting important spells from the graveyard. Overall, this deck aims to control the game through a combination of card advantage, disruption, and efficient threats.

This Vintage 1 vs 1 deck focuses on assembling a powerful Storm combo using cards like Tendrils of Agony, Black Lotus, and Bolas's Citadel. The goal is to generate a high storm count by casting spells quickly and efficiently, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a lethal Tendrils of Agony finish. The deck includes powerful mana acceleration with Moxen and rituals, along with disruption and card selection to help find key combo pieces. It aims to win the game in a single explosive turn using the Storm mechanic to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent.

The focus of this Aggro-MUD Vintage deck is to generate fast mana and utilize artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes powerful artifact mana sources like Sol Ring, Mana Crypt, and the Moxen, as well as synergistic cards like Grim Monolith and Manifold Key. With cards like Nettlecyst and Glaring Fleshraker to pump creatures and disrupt the opponent, this deck aims to quickly establish a dominant board presence and close out the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on denying the opponent's resources while utilizing efficient card draw and countermagic to maintain control of the game. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Wasteland, and Null Rod, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value by allowing the deck to recast key threats or disruption spells from the graveyard. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and grinding out a win through attrition.

The deck focuses on using artifacts and disruptive elements to slow down opponents while ramping up mana quickly to deploy threats. It seeks to overload opponents with taxing effects like Sphere of Resistance, while disrupting their strategies with cards like Null Rod and Chalice of the Void. This allows the deck to control the pace of the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Stonecoil Serpent. The deck aims to create a lockout scenario where opponents are unable to effectively play their spells while the pilot builds up a dominant board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent with taxing effects like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst while using powerful artifacts like Crucible of Worlds and Nettlecyst to maintain board presence and control. It also includes mana denial cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland to slow down the opponent, alongside efficient beaters like Stonecoil Serpent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of disruptive elements and aggressive threats, utilizing the resource denial strategy of MUD archetype to its fullest potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful synergy between Hermit Druid and Thassa's Oracle to win the game quickly and efficiently. By milling the library with Hermit Druid and then casting Thassa's Oracle, the deck can win the game on the spot. The rest of the deck is designed to support this combo with various tutor effects, protection spells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, and disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional resilience and value to the deck.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on using powerful counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation to control the game. It also utilizes cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The deck has card advantage with spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, while also having disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog and Orcish Bowmasters. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by recasting low mana cost spells from the graveyard.

The main concept of this Dredge combo deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards using self-milling effects like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, and then utilize graveyard recursion and creature synergy to overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam provide additional value when they are put into play from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect the combo pieces. Overall, the goal is to outpace and outvalue the opponent by leveraging the graveyard as a resource.

The deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with disruptive hate cards to slow down the opponent's game plan. By playing hatebears like Anointed Peacekeeper, Archon of Emeria, and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck aims to control the board and limit the opponent's options. With cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer providing card advantage, the deck can maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen accelerates the deck's game plan, allowing for explosive plays and early aggression.

The deck focuses on playing powerful artifacts and creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thorn of Amethyst, Null Rod, Sphere of Resistance, and Crucible of Worlds. Golos, Tireless Pilgrim allows for ramp and card advantage, while Mishra's Workshop provides additional mana for casting expensive spells. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Stonecoil Serpent and Lodestone Golem, while also utilizing the powerful abilities of Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge to further solidify its advantage.

This Vintage Combo - Storm deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana through fast mana artifacts like Black Lotus and Sol Ring, as well as ritual spells like Dark Ritual. The goal is to assemble a combo of Tendrils of Agony along with other spells like Bolas's Citadel and Stock Up to create a storm count high enough to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes disruption like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful mana base quickly with artifact accelerators like Moxen and Mana Crypt, allowing for explosive plays early on. It utilizes Mystic Forge to dig for key combo pieces and a variety of creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Scrawling Crawler to apply pressure on opponents. The deck also includes a lock combo with Karn, the Great Creator and cards like The One Ring and Nettlecyst to disrupt opponents' strategies and secure the win. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast, aggressive strategy fueled by powerful artifacts.

The deck focuses on utilizing various control elements such as counterspells, removal, and disruptive creatures to control the board and dominate the game. It also features powerful draw and card advantage cards to maintain card quality and outvalue opponents. By establishing control early with efficient removal and disruption, the deck aims to create a strong board presence and lock opponents out of the game while steadily advancing its own win conditions. The addition of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion further enhances the deck's consistency and staying power in longer games.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Mishra's Workshop, Mana Crypt, and Mana Vault, to allow for explosive plays with cards like Tinker and Paradoxical Outcome. The goal is to combo off by using cards such as Mana Vault and Grim Monolith to generate extra mana, then using Paradoxical Outcome to bounce multiple artifacts back to hand for maximum value. Additionally, the deck includes powerful artifact synergies like Voltaic Key and Ancestral Recall to further enable the combo potential.
